brief_description: Extended-run PicoRV32 ez testbench — 50,000 clock cycles instead of the stock 1,000 — captured as VCD then converted to FST via vcd2fst. Raw VCD was 14.3 MB; FST compression brings it to 537 KB. Provides the medium-scale event-count axis: hundreds of thousands of value updates across the picorv32 core's full hierarchy. Built locally with a one-line patch to repeat-count + vcd2fst.
anchors: scope `testbench.uut` is the picorv32 core (deep hierarchy)
memory address 0x3fc holds the loop counter incrementing on each iteration
trace ends at simulation time 501,000,000 ps (~501 us)
